title: Typing hours into the timesheet no longer waits for the server
description: A cell used to hold its old number until the save came back and the page redrew. Now the week updates as you type, and a save the portal refuses puts the cell back exactly as it was, with the reason.
items: Submitting a week locks it on the click, and cancelling a submission unlocks it the same way
Going back to a week you have already opened shows it at once
The team week no longer counts leave that has only been requested as time off — only approved leave excuses a missing timesheet
